title: Indian Players, Coaches Debate Badminton's New 3x15 Scoring System
indian_angle: India is at the forefront of testing the new 3x15 scoring system domestically, making this a crucial topic for Indian badminton's future.
summary: Starting in 2027, badminton will shift from three games of 21 points to three games of 15. India is already testing this format domestically, with players, coaches, and organizers debating whether shorter games will enhance the sport or alter its essence.

title: India Announces Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior World Championships Trials
indian_angle: This update directly impacts the composition of India's potential women's doubles team for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India announced a change in the women's doubles pairing for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati for Asia Championships
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for developing India's next generation of badminton stars for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Final Selection Trials List Released for BWF World Junior Championships
indian_angle: Indian badminton fans will be keen to see which young talents have qualified for the final trials to represent the nation at the World Junior Championships.
summary: The list of eligible and qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, has been released.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Indian Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact the development and competitive experience of young Indian badminton players in national events.
summary: The 3x15 scoring system has been implemented for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: The Evolution of Indian Badminton: A Historical Perspective
indian_angle: This feature offers valuable insight into the historical development and institutional growth of badminton within India.
summary: A historical look at the 17 years of quiet, unglamorous institution-building that shaped Indian badminton, particularly between Hyderabad and Delhi.
